units: Ḥull. 17ᵃ נ׳ שלהן וכ׳ the stabbing of them is named sh’ḥiṭah.
<cite ref="Chullin 17a:12">Ib.</cite> <he>בשר נ׳</he> flesh of an animal killed by stabbing (instead of ritual cutting).
<cite ref="Mishnah Keritot 5:1">Ker. V, 1</cite> <he>דם נ׳</he> blood of a stabbed animal; a. e.

senses.gloss: the mucous discharge of a healing wound.
